name: DSPy
author: stanfordnlp
one_liner: Python framework whose optimizers (MIPROv2, GEPA and others) tune prompts and weights to maximize a metric you write.

loop.proposes: candidate instructions and few-shot examples for each module
loop.judged_by: a metric function you write that scores program outputs
loop.steers: optimizers such as MIPROv2 (Bayesian search) and COPRO (hill-climbing) keep the settings that raise the metric

not_proved: A prompt tuned on a metric and a training set is only as good as that metric; gains may not carry to new inputs or to what the metric misses.
